Within the combinatorial methodology of the *Paṭṭhāna*, this text addresses conditional relations by crossing the dyad of states that are dissociated from the corruptions/cankers but subject to them (*āsavavippayuttasāsavaduka*) with the fundamental triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states (*kusalattika*) [SuttaCentral].
